description: This Java class defines an immutable range of dates, extending a generic ComparableRange to provide specific functionality related to date ranges, including range boundaries, duration, containment, and intersection checks.

classes.name: DateRange
classes.description: An immutable range of dates providing range boundary, duration, inclusion, and intersection functionalities.

methods.name: durationInMillis
methods.description: Returns the duration of the date range in milliseconds.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns a clone of the end date of the range.

methods.name: endStamp
methods.description: Returns the end date as a Timestamp.

methods.name: includesDate
methods.description: Checks if a given date occurs within this range.

methods.name: intersectsRange
methods.description: Checks whether the provided start and end dates or another DateRange intersect with this range.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Returns a clone of the start date of the range.

methods.name: startStamp
methods.description: Returns the start date as a Timestamp.
